scope_limits: This report verifies manuscript content, cited methodological scope, topic-aligned captions and educational arithmetic. It is not browser, build or deployment verification.
Original source/crop visual review belongs to the separate image review. Figure dimensions and web rendering are not newly certified by this report.
The caption provider identifies the track as manual. Exact video-frame transitions and audio transcription were not independently measured.
Only metadata and paraphrases are added to repository transcript provenance. Raw caption excerpts remain in scratch research files.

The existing numerical script was run once without --output and matched its saved result exactly. Separate exact closed-form and posterior-odds calculations were performed; no model training or benchmark reproduction occurred.
